description: Optional named coverage targets for material-world generation. These sets are metadata for targeted probes and soft upweighting; default generation does not use them unless coverage_set_ids or coverage_mix is set in the pipeline config.

coverage_sets.description: Materials, objects, and property contrasts from the EWoK material-properties domain, adapted for natural BabyLM material-world prose.
generation_guidance: Use the coverage materials and objects as anchors, but render ordinary prose rather than benchmark-style minimal pairs.
Prefer plausible everyday object-material pairings when possible.
When an EWoK pairing is intentionally odd, make the text clearly hypothetical or pretend instead of claiming it is common.
Keep final training text natural; do not mention EWoK, coverage sets, concept labels, or test names in generated prose.

coverage_sets.description: Action and behavior concepts from the EWoK material-dynamics domain, adapted for natural BabyLM material-world prose.
generation_guidance: Use these dynamic concepts as visible actions or material behaviors in natural prose.
Keep dynamics concrete: a person can tap, stir, squeeze, fold, rip, or drape something; a material can drip, ripple, splash, wrinkle, flap, pile, or break.
Do not mention EWoK, coverage sets, concept labels, or test names in generated prose.
